assets.what: the dog: 172 distinct drawings exposed in the film (proof/dog_sprite_set.png, proof/dog_sprite_set.json)
assets.source: drawn in code for this film: ink-outlined spheres and tapered capsules placed by a 20-point pose guide, colour masks for the saddle, bib and legs
assets.operation: drawn; each drawing is a discrete sprite key; animation is selection of drawings on the exposure sheet (build/xsheet.json), no interpolation between drawings at render time

assets.what: shape and markings reference only (a shepherd-type dog with a dark saddle); no pixels, masks or rig keys used
assets.source: Amateur Film New Jersey C, Home Movies collection, Internet Archive

assets.what: the person: profile figure and ten profile visemes (X, MBP, AA, OO, EE, R, FV, L, TS, KG)
assets.operation: drawn; viseme chosen per frame from the synthesizer phones with a 40 ms lead

assets.what: dusk sky, tree line, moon, clapboard house, window, doorway, door panel, lamp-lit room, porch deck, sill, steps, post, door light
arcs at the mouth and at the dog ear (from the voice line RMS envelope), the spoken words set in type as they are spoken, ticks for paws, puffs for sniffs, scratch lines for the hinge
dusk room tone: filtered noise air and three synthesized crickets
person footsteps, sitting, palm on door, cloth; hinge creak (stick-slip impulse train through resonant filters); dog nails on boards, body thumps, sniffs, sighs, tail on boards
assets.operation: synthesized; dog footfalls placed where a leg of the exposed walk drawing goes from swing to stance

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display 800, JetBrains Mono 400, Literata 400 and italic
assets.operation: used for the cards and the spoken words

assets.what: the PAELEO threshold score (dog x per frame, choice times)
assets.operation: read: position and choices; all timing of answers is derived from the sound events
